g.text: Dynamic plasma load: impedance and 50 Ω Smith-chart interpretation

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Smith center = 50+j0 Ω (no reflection); outer circle = complete reflection.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: Lower half = capacitive; gray circle is pulse-off and orange square is on-state.

text.style: font-size: 6.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #68737d

g.text: These are frozen-state plasma-load values before matching, not measured source-plane S11 and not a kinetic plasma solution.
